subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or keep the linked production reports as separate bug-specific tracks?
rationale: Source evidence supports the problem class, but choosing a single lifecycle owner, liveness policy, restart persistence model, and completion-drive behavior changes stable gateway/session behavior and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the canonical direction and require Track A-D to land as focused PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve only Track A now
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale-lane reclaim as the immediate direction while deferring crash-resume and completion-drive policy.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella as canonical and continue resolving the linked production reports with narrower fixes.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the canonical direction and require Track A-D to land as focused PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, self-assigned, and opened the linked Track A implementation candidate for this umbrella.
